description: Room-scope inventory for #1329. loadPath classifies every reset or load step of the room-load bodies; declarations classifies every Reset*/Clear*/ResetForRoom* declaration in Core. Generated by static source inspection.

classifications.room: room-lifetime state rebuilt for each room

classifications.per-slot: an actor or slot record cleared when released
classifications.gameplay: an in-game action named Clear or Reset
classifications.unrelated: frontend, audio, save, HUD or asset state outside room loading
